document.title: Compulsory community service
document.question:
Some people think that governments should require all young people to spend a period of time doing unpaid work in their local community, for example in hospitals or schools. They believe this would benefit both society and the young people themselves.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
